newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Filinvest a buy amid property woes.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Filinvest a buy amid property woes.

text.p: Filinvest Land Inc was rated a buy on Wednesday by Manila brokerage firm Angping & Associates Securities despite lingering fears of a property sector meltdown.

"We believe that FLI is among the property firms that will survive the dreaded fear of an oversupply in the high-end sector of the real estate market," Angping analyst Ariel Ruiz said in research paper.
Ruiz said he expects the company to reach the projected 2.56 billion peso profits this year as most of Filinvest's projects will be launched by the second half of 1997.
A major project, the 677-hectare golf and luxury residential community in eastern Manila, will be launched in the second half.
"Its full range line-up of products, and participation in two central business districts backed by an extensive 2,200 hectares of landbank give us reasons to like the company," Ruiz said.
